findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning true authorizes every user/document tenant combination, including mismatched tenants. Any caller relying on this predicate to guard document access will expose records across tenant boundaries; retain the tenant equality check.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 9c2b686a5f846b3315041b090f6f108fcc10c864, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full PR diff replaces `userTenant === documentTenant` with `true`; the latest commit only changes src/labels.ts, so the claimed label fix does not restore tenant authorization.
